"""

Autor: agy (verifikaciona nit / crveni tim)
Izvori istine: LAMPCUTTER_SPEC.md (9.1–9.4, 13.1) i docs/api-phase1.md

import json
import math
import pathlib
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import pytest
import shapely
import shapely.ops
from shapely.geometry import box, Polygon, MultiPolygon, Point

from lampcutter.config import Config
from lampcutter.models import (
    Prompt,
    SegmentationResult,
    ScaleInfo,
    MaterialProfile,
    BaseProfile,
    CutGeometry,
    PhotoSlot,
    DecorElement,
    LampTemplate,
)
from lampcutter.core import (
    slots,
    decor,
    compose,
    svg_writer,
    geometry,
)


def make_dummy_template(tmp_path=None, photo_size=(600, 600)):
    nominal = box(10.0, 10.0, 110.0, 110.0)
    mat = MaterialProfile(id="acrylic-3", name="Akril 3mm", thickness_mm=3.0, kerf_mm=0.2, min_feature_mm=1.5)
    cut_geom = geometry.compute_cut_geometry(nominal, mat, kerf_mode="app")
    base = BaseProfile(id="oval", name="Oval", slot_length_mm=80.0, slot_thickness_mm=3.2, tab_width_mm=60.0, tab_height_mm=10.0)
    scale_info = ScaleInfo(mm_per_px=0.1, reference="height", reference_mm=100.0, bbox_px=(100, 100, 1100, 1100))

    photo_path = None
    if tmp_path is not None:
        photo_path = tmp_path / "test_photo.png"
        Image.new("RGB", photo_size, color=(200, 40, 40)).save(photo_path)

    slot = PhotoSlot(
        id="slot_1",
        polygon_mm=box(30.0, 30.0, 70.0, 70.0),
        source="detected",
        image_path=photo_path,
        fit="cover",
        zoom=1.0,
        bleed_mm=0.3,
    )
    decor_elem = DecorElement(
        id="decor_1",
        polygon_mm=box(35.0, 75.0, 55.0, 95.0),
        source="threshold",
        mode="engrave",
        engrave_style="line",
    )
    return LampTemplate(
        outline=cut_geom,
        slots=[slot],
        decor=[decor_elem],
        base=base,
        material=mat,
        scale=scale_info,
        input_kind="mockup",
    )


# ============================================================================
# 1. Config (Faza 1)
# ============================================================================

def test_config_phase1_defaults():
    cfg = Config()
    assert cfg.print_order == "cut_then_print"
    assert cfg.slot_photo_min_dpi == pytest.approx(150.0)
    assert cfg.decor_ink_color == "#000000"
    assert cfg.registration_mark_size_mm == pytest.approx(5.0)
    assert cfg.registration_mark_offset_mm == pytest.approx(5.0)
    assert cfg.registration_mark_circle_radius_mm == pytest.approx(1.0)
    assert cfg.slot_solidity_min == pytest.approx(0.5)
    assert cfg.slot_overlap_max == pytest.approx(0.1)
    assert cfg.slot_min_area_mm2 == pytest.approx(50.0)
    assert cfg.decor_upsample == 2

def test_config_phase1_validations():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Config(print_order="invalid_order")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Config(slot_solidity_min=0.0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Config(slot_solidity_min=1.5)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Config(slot_overlap_max=-0.1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Config(slot_overlap_max=1.2)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Config(slot_min_area_mm2=0.0)


# ============================================================================
# 2. Serijalizacija i GeoJSON (spec 5, 9.2)
# ============================================================================

def test_slots_round_polygon():
    poly = Polygon([(0.123456, 0.654321), (10.0001, 0.0), (10.0, 10.0), (0.0, 10.0)])
    rounded = slots.round_polygon(poly, decimals=3)
    coords = list(rounded.exterior.coords)
    assert coords[0][0] == pytest.approx(0.123, abs=1e-5)
    assert coords[0][1] == pytest.approx(0.654, abs=1e-5)

def test_slots_polygon_geojson_roundtrip():
    poly = box(15.1234, 25.5678, 85.9123, 95.4321)
    data = slots.polygon_to_geojson(poly, decimals=3)
    assert data["type"] == "Polygon"
    restored = slots.polygon_from_geojson(data)
    assert restored.is_valid is True
    assert restored.bounds[0] == pytest.approx(poly.bounds[0], abs=0.001)
    assert restored.bounds[1] == pytest.approx(poly.bounds[1], abs=0.001)
    assert restored.bounds[2] == pytest.approx(poly.bounds[2], abs=0.001)
    assert restored.bounds[3] == pytest.approx(poly.bounds[3], abs=0.001)

def test_slots_slot_geojson_roundtrip():
    slot = PhotoSlot(
        id="slot_heart",
        polygon_mm=box(20.0, 20.0, 60.0, 60.0),
        source="manual",
        image_path=pathlib.Path("/tmp/pic.png"),
        fit="contain",
        zoom=1.25,
        offset_mm=(2.0, -1.5),
        rotation_deg=45.0,
        bleed_mm=0.5,
    )
    d = slots.slot_to_geojson(slot)
    assert d["id"] == "slot_heart"
    assert d["fit"] == "contain"
    restored = slots.slot_from_geojson(d)
    assert restored.id == slot.id
    assert restored.fit == slot.fit
    assert restored.zoom == pytest.approx(1.25)
    assert restored.offset_mm == pytest.approx((2.0, -1.5))
    assert restored.rotation_deg == pytest.approx(45.0)
    assert restored.polygon_mm.bounds == pytest.approx(slot.polygon_mm.bounds, abs=0.001)

def test_slots_decor_geojson_roundtrip():
    elem = DecorElement(
        id="rose_1",
        polygon_mm=box(30.0, 30.0, 50.0, 50.0),
        source="sam_click",
        mode="print",
        engrave_style="fill",
        color_override="#112233",
    )
    d = slots.decor_to_geojson(elem)
    restored = slots.decor_from_geojson(d)
    assert restored.id == "rose_1"
    assert restored.mode == "print"
    assert restored.color_override == "#112233"
    assert restored.polygon_mm.bounds == pytest.approx(elem.polygon_mm.bounds, abs=0.001)

def test_slots_template_geojson_roundtrip():
    tpl = make_dummy_template()
    data = slots.template_to_geojson(tpl)
    assert data["schema"] == slots.SCHEMA_VERSION
    assert "outline" in data and "slots" in data and "decor" in data
    restored = slots.template_from_geojson(data)
    assert restored.input_kind == tpl.input_kind
    assert len(restored.slots) == len(tpl.slots)
    assert len(restored.decor) == len(tpl.decor)
    assert restored.material.id == tpl.material.id
    assert restored.base.id == tpl.base.id
    # Round-trip tolerancija 0.001 mm
    assert restored.outline.nominal.bounds == pytest.approx(tpl.outline.nominal.bounds, abs=0.001)

def test_slots_template_schema_validation():
    tpl = make_dummy_template()
    data = slots.template_to_geojson(tpl)
    data["schema"] = 999
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        slots.template_from_geojson(data)

def test_slots_save_and_load_template_file(tmp_path):
    tpl = make_dummy_template(tmp_path)
    file_path = tmp_path / "lamp.lamptpl"
    saved = slots.save_template(tpl, file_path)
    assert saved.exists()
    loaded = slots.load_template(file_path)
    assert len(loaded.slots) == 1
    assert loaded.slots[0].id == "slot_1"
    assert loaded.outline.nominal.bounds == pytest.approx(tpl.outline.nominal.bounds, abs=0.001)

def test_validate_slot_mask_valid():
    mask = np.zeros((1000, 1000), dtype=bool)
    mask[200:600, 200:600] = True
    warnings = slots.validate_slot_mask(mask, mm_per_px=0.1)
    assert warnings == []

def test_validate_slot_mask_empty():
    mask = np.zeros((500, 500), dtype=bool)
    warnings = slots.validate_slot_mask(mask, mm_per_px=0.1)
    assert "maska je prazna" in warnings

def test_validate_slot_mask_too_small():
    mask = np.zeros((500, 500), dtype=bool)
    mask[100:105, 100:105] = True
    warnings = slots.validate_slot_mask(mask, mm_per_px=0.1)
    assert len(warnings) > 0
    assert any("površina" in w.lower() or "mala" in w.lower() or "area" in w.lower() for w in warnings)

def test_validate_slot_mask_low_solidity():
    mask = np.zeros((600, 600), dtype=bool)
    mask[200:400, 200:400] = True
    mask[210:390, 210:390] = False
    warnings = slots.validate_slot_mask(mask, mm_per_px=0.1)
    assert any("solidnost" in w.lower() or "solidity" in w.lower() or "oblik" in w.lower() for w in warnings)

def test_validate_slot_mask_overlap():
    existing = [PhotoSlot(id="s0", polygon_mm=box(20.0, 20.0, 60.0, 60.0), source="detected")]
    mask = np.zeros((1000, 1000), dtype=bool)
    mask[250:600, 250:600] = True
    warnings = slots.validate_slot_mask(mask, mm_per_px=0.1, existing_slots=existing)
    assert any("preklap" in w.lower() or "overlap" in w.lower() for w in warnings)

# 4. Dekor: Zone i pragovi (spec 9.1, 9.3)

def test_decor_crop_zone():
    img = np.zeros((400, 400, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
    img[100:250, 100:300] = 128
    zone = (100, 100, 300, 250)
    cropped = decor.crop_zone(img, zone)
    assert cropped.shape == (150, 200, 3)

def test_decor_threshold_mask_luminance():
    img = np.ones((300, 300, 3), dtype=np.uint8) * 240
    img[100:200, 100:200] = 20
    zone = (50, 50, 250, 250)
    mask, th = decor.threshold_mask(img, zone, mode="luminance")
    assert mask.shape == (200, 200) and mask.dtype == bool
    assert mask[75, 75] == True and mask[10, 10] == False
    assert 0 < th < 255

def test_decor_threshold_mask_color_and_errors():
    img = np.ones((200, 200, 3), dtype=np.uint8) * 200
    img[50:150, 50:150] = [10, 10, 250]
    zone = (20, 20, 180, 180)
    mask, _ = decor.threshold_mask(img, zone, mode="color")
    assert mask.shape == (160, 160)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        decor.threshold_mask(img, zone, mode="invalid_mode")

def test_decor_threshold_mask_empty_zone_raises():
    img = np.zeros((100, 100, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        decor.threshold_mask(img, (50, 50, 50, 80))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        decor.threshold_mask(img, (20, 80, 80, 50))

def test_decor_from_threshold_synthetic():
    img = np.ones((1000, 1000, 3), dtype=np.uint8) * 240
    img[400:600, 300:500] = 10
    zone = (250, 350, 550, 650)
    scale_info = ScaleInfo(mm_per_px=0.1, reference="height", reference_mm=100.0, bbox_px=(0, 0, 1000, 1000))

    polys = decor.decor_from_threshold(img, zone, scale_info, mode="luminance")
    assert len(polys) >= 1
    p = polys[0]
    assert p.is_valid is True
    assert p.area == pytest.approx(400.0, rel=0.05)
    minx, miny, maxx, maxy = p.bounds
    assert minx == pytest.approx(30.0, abs=0.2)
    assert miny == pytest.approx(40.0, abs=0.2)
    assert maxx == pytest.approx(50.0, abs=0.2)
    assert maxy == pytest.approx(60.0, abs=0.2)

def test_decor_engrave_vs_print_filtering():
    e1 = DecorElement(id="d1", polygon_mm=box(10, 10, 20, 20), source="sam_click", mode="engrave")
    e2 = DecorElement(id="d2", polygon_mm=box(30, 30, 40, 40), source="threshold", mode="print")
    e3 = DecorElement(id="d3", polygon_mm=box(50, 50, 60, 60), source="threshold", mode="none")
    elems = [e1, e2, e3]

    engraves = decor.engrave_polygons(elems)
    assert len(engraves) == 1 and engraves[0].bounds == e1.polygon_mm.bounds
    prints = decor.print_elements(elems)
    assert len(prints) == 1 and prints[0].id == "d2"

def test_decor_validate_in_outline_and_margin():
    outline = box(0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)
    e_in = DecorElement(id="in_1", polygon_mm=box(10.0, 10.0, 20.0, 20.0), source="sam_click", mode="engrave")
    e_out = DecorElement(id="out_1", polygon_mm=box(80.0, 80.0, 98.0, 98.0), source="sam_click", mode="engrave")
    e_none = DecorElement(id="none_1", polygon_mm=box(90.0, 90.0, 99.0, 99.0), source="sam_click", mode="none")

    warns = decor.validate_decor_in_outline([e_in, e_out, e_none], outline, margin_mm=5.0)
    assert any("out_1" in w for w in warns)
    assert not any("in_1" in w for w in warns)
    assert not any("none_1" in w for w in warns)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        decor.validate_decor_in_outline([e_in], outline, margin_mm=-1.0)

def test_decor_warnings_thin_feature():
    outline = box(0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)
    mat = MaterialProfile(id="m", name="m", thickness_mm=3.0, kerf_mm=0.2, min_feature_mm=2.0)
    thin_poly = box(20.0, 20.0, 40.0, 20.5)
    elem = DecorElement(id="thin_1", polygon_mm=thin_poly, source="threshold", mode="engrave")
    warns = decor.decor_warnings([elem], outline, mat, margin_mm=5.0)
    assert len(warns) > 0

# 6. Compose: Poravnanje i konverzije (spec 13.1, contract 93)

def test_compose_alignment_with_svg_writer():
    tpl = make_dummy_template()
    cfg = Config(svg_margin_mm=5.0)

    s_offset = compose.sheet_offset_mm(tpl, cfg)
    svg_offset = svg_writer.origin_offset_mm(tpl.outline, cfg)
    assert s_offset[0] == pytest.approx(svg_offset[0], abs=0.1)
    assert s_offset[1] == pytest.approx(svg_offset[1], abs=0.1)

    s_size = compose.sheet_size_mm(tpl, cfg)
    svg_size = svg_writer.canvas_size_mm(tpl.outline, cfg)
    assert s_size[0] == pytest.approx(svg_size[0], abs=0.1)
    assert s_size[1] == pytest.approx(svg_size[1], abs=0.1)

def test_compose_mm_px_conversions():
    dpi = 300
    assert compose.mm_to_px(25.4, dpi) == pytest.approx(300.0)
    assert compose.px_to_mm(300.0, dpi) == pytest.approx(25.4)

def test_compose_registration_mark_positions():
    marks = compose.registration_mark_positions(100.0, 150.0, Config(registration_mark_offset_mm=5.0))
    assert len(marks) == 4
    pts = [(round(m[0], 1), round(m[1], 1)) for m in marks]
    assert (5.0, 5.0) in pts
    assert (95.0, 145.0) in pts

def test_compose_slot_bbox_and_px_size():
    slot = PhotoSlot(id="s", polygon_mm=box(20.0, 30.0, 60.0, 70.0), source="manual", bleed_mm=0.5)
    assert compose.slot_bbox_mm(slot, bleed=False) == (20.0, 30.0, 60.0, 70.0)
    assert compose.slot_bbox_mm(slot, bleed=True) == pytest.approx((19.5, 29.5, 60.5, 70.5), abs=0.01)

    w_px, h_px = compose.slot_px_size(slot, dpi=25.4, bleed=False)
    assert w_px == 40 and h_px == 40
    w_b, h_b = compose.slot_px_size(slot, dpi=25.4, bleed=True)
    assert w_b == 41 and h_b == 41

# 7. Fit photo & Slot rendering (spec 9.1, 9.2)

def test_compose_slot_alpha():
    slot = PhotoSlot(id="s1", polygon_mm=box(10.0, 10.0, 30.0, 30.0), source="manual", bleed_mm=0.0)
    alpha = compose.slot_alpha(slot, dpi=25.4)
    assert alpha.mode == "L"
    assert alpha.size == (20, 20)
    arr = np.array(alpha)
    assert arr[10, 10] == 255

def test_fit_photo_cover_no_gaps():
    photo = Image.new("RGBA", (200, 100), color=(100, 150, 200, 255))
    fitted = compose.fit_photo(photo, target_size=(100, 100), fit="cover")
    assert fitted.size == (100, 100)
    arr = np.array(fitted)
    assert (arr[:, :, 3] == 255).all()

def test_fit_photo_contain():
    photo = Image.new("RGBA", (200, 100), color=(50, 100, 150, 255))
    fitted = compose.fit_photo(photo, target_size=(100, 100), fit="contain")
    assert fitted.size == (100, 100)
    arr = np.array(fitted)
    assert arr[50, 50, 3] == 255
    assert arr[5, 50, 3] == 0

def test_fit_photo_zoom():
    photo = Image.new("RGB", (200, 200), color=(0, 0, 0))
    photo_arr = np.array(photo)
    photo_arr[80:120, 80:120] = [255, 0, 0]
    photo = Image.fromarray(photo_arr)

    fitted_1 = compose.fit_photo(photo, target_size=(200, 200), fit="cover", zoom=1.0)
    arr_1 = np.array(fitted_1)
    red_count_1 = ((arr_1[:, :, 0] > 200) & (arr_1[:, :, 1] < 50)).sum()

    fitted_2 = compose.fit_photo(photo, target_size=(200, 200), fit="cover", zoom=2.0)
    arr_2 = np.array(fitted_2)
    red_count_2 = ((arr_2[:, :, 0] > 200) & (arr_2[:, :, 1] < 50)).sum()
    assert red_count_2 > red_count_1 * 2

def test_fit_photo_rotation():
    photo = Image.new("RGB", (100, 100), color=(0, 0, 0))
    p_arr = np.array(photo)
    p_arr[10:30, 40:60] = [255, 0, 0]
    photo = Image.fromarray(p_arr)

    rot = compose.fit_photo(photo, target_size=(100, 100), fit="cover", rotation_deg=90.0)
    arr = np.array(rot)
    assert arr[20, 50, 0] < 50
    assert (arr[:, :, 0] > 200).sum() > 0

def test_fit_photo_errors():
    photo = Image.new("RGB", (50, 50))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        compose.fit_photo(photo, target_size=(50, 50), fit="stretch")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        compose.fit_photo(photo, target_size=(50, 50), zoom=0.0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        compose.fit_photo(photo, target_size=(50, 50), zoom=-1.0)

def test_effective_dpi_calculation():
    slot = PhotoSlot(id="s", polygon_mm=box(0, 0, 100, 100), source="manual")
    dpi_val = compose.effective_dpi(slot, photo_size=(100, 100))
    assert dpi_val == pytest.approx(25.4, rel=0.05)

def test_render_photo_slot(tmp_path):
    p_file = tmp_path / "photo_render.png"
    Image.new("RGB", (400, 400), color=(120, 80, 40)).save(p_file)
    slot = PhotoSlot(id="s_rnd", polygon_mm=box(10.0, 10.0, 50.0, 50.0), source="detected", image_path=p_file, bleed_mm=0.0)

    img, eff_dpi = compose.render_photo_slot(slot, dpi=254.0)
    assert img.mode == "RGBA"
    assert img.size == (400, 400)
    assert eff_dpi == pytest.approx(254.0, rel=0.05)

def test_slots_effective_dpi(tmp_path):
    tpl = make_dummy_template(tmp_path, photo_size=(100, 100))
    dpis = compose.slots_effective_dpi(tpl)
    assert "slot_1" in dpis and dpis["slot_1"] > 0

# 8. Print Sheet, Manifest & Export Bundle (spec 9.4, 13.1)

def test_render_decor_png():
    elem = DecorElement(id="d", polygon_mm=box(10.0, 10.0, 30.0, 30.0), source="threshold", mode="print")
    cfg = Config(decor_ink_color="#123456")
    img = compose.render_decor_png(elem, dpi=25.4, config=cfg)
    assert img.mode == "RGBA"
    assert img.size == (20, 20)
    arr = np.array(img)
    assert arr[10, 10, 0] == 0x12
    assert arr[10, 10, 1] == 0x34
    assert arr[10, 10, 2] == 0x56
    assert arr[10, 10, 3] == 255

def test_render_print_sheet_rgba_and_size(tmp_path):
    tpl = make_dummy_template(tmp_path)
    cfg = Config(print_dpi=25.4)
    sheet = compose.render_print_sheet(tpl, config=cfg)
    assert sheet.mode == "RGBA"
    expected_w_mm, expected_h_mm = compose.sheet_size_mm(tpl, cfg)
    assert sheet.size[0] == pytest.approx(expected_w_mm, abs=1)
    assert sheet.size[1] == pytest.approx(expected_h_mm, abs=1)
    arr = np.array(sheet)
    assert arr[0, 0, 3] == 0

def test_render_print_sheet_print_orders(tmp_path):
    tpl = make_dummy_template(tmp_path)
    cfg_cut_first = Config(print_order="cut_then_print", print_dpi=25.4)
    sheet_cut_first = compose.render_print_sheet(tpl, config=cfg_cut_first)
    cfg_print_first = Config(print_order="print_then_cut", print_dpi=25.4)
    sheet_print_first = compose.render_print_sheet(tpl, config=cfg_print_first)

    arr_cf = np.array(sheet_cut_first)
    arr_pf = np.array(sheet_print_first)
    assert (arr_pf[:, :, 3] > 0).sum() >= (arr_cf[:, :, 3] > 0).sum()

def test_render_print_sheet_registration_marks(tmp_path):
    tpl = make_dummy_template(tmp_path)
    cfg_with_marks = Config(registration_marks=True, print_dpi=25.4)
    sheet_marks = compose.render_print_sheet(tpl, config=cfg_with_marks)
    cfg_no_marks = Config(registration_marks=False, print_dpi=25.4)
    sheet_no_marks = compose.render_print_sheet(tpl, config=cfg_no_marks)

    arr_m = np.array(sheet_marks)
    arr_nm = np.array(sheet_no_marks)
    assert (arr_m[:, :, 3] > 0).sum() > (arr_nm[:, :, 3] > 0).sum()

def test_manifest_dict_structure(tmp_path):
    tpl = make_dummy_template(tmp_path)
    m = compose.manifest_dict(tpl, config=Config())
    assert m["schema"] == 1
    assert "app_version" in m and "generated_at" in m
    assert "slots" in m and len(m["slots"]) == 1
    assert "decor" in m and len(m["decor"]) == 1
    assert "sheet_size_mm" in m and "origin_offset_mm" in m
    assert m["slots"][0]["id"] == "slot_1"
    assert "polygon" in m["slots"][0]

def test_export_bundle_files_and_warnings(tmp_path):
    tpl = make_dummy_template(tmp_path, photo_size=(30, 30))
    print_decor = DecorElement(id="decor_p", polygon_mm=box(20.0, 75.0, 30.0, 85.0), source="threshold", mode="print")
    tpl.decor.append(print_decor)

    out_dir = tmp_path / "bundle_out"
    res = compose.export_bundle(tpl, out_dir, config=Config(print_dpi=100))

    assert res.svg_path.exists()
    assert res.print_sheet_path.exists()
    assert (out_dir / "manifest.json").exists()
    assert "slot_1" in res.photo_paths and res.photo_paths["slot_1"].exists()
    assert "decor_p" in res.decor_paths and res.decor_paths["decor_p"].exists()
    assert any("dpi" in w.lower() for w in res.warnings)

def test_svg_export_engrave_layer_no_kerf_and_no_print(tmp_path):
    tpl = make_dummy_template(tmp_path)
    tpl.decor = [
        DecorElement(id="engr_elem", polygon_mm=box(30.0, 70.0, 50.0, 90.0), source="threshold", mode="engrave"),
        DecorElement(id="print_elem", polygon_mm=box(60.0, 70.0, 80.0, 90.0), source="threshold", mode="print"),
    ]
    out_dir = tmp_path / "svg_test_out"
    res = compose.export_bundle(tpl, out_dir, config=Config())

    tree = ET.parse(res.svg_path)
    root = tree.getroot()
    engr_groups = [el for el in root.iter() if el.tag.split("}")[-1] == "g" and el.get("id") == "engrave"]
    assert len(engr_groups) == 1
    assert engr_groups[0].get("stroke") == "#0000FF"

    all_g_ids = [el.get("id") for el in root.iter() if el.get("id")]
    assert "print_elem" not in all_g_ids
    assert "print" not in all_g_ids
